context: Sakura signs a book at a small bookstore; Hina-young gets one.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: さくらさん、本、署名してください!
lines.en: Sakura, will you sign my book?
lines.style: Bright, unbridled excitement. Rushes the opening. Bouncing energy barely contained. Asks with the kind of earnestness only an eight-year-old can muster — this is a real request, not a performance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Warm, immediate delight. No hesitation — she's genuinely touched. Soft smile in the voice. Settles into the moment like she's been waiting for this. Unhurried, genuine.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: I'm so happy I get to be your reader!
lines.style: Pure joy, no filter. Voice rises slightly on 「嬉しい」. Bright and present. The kind of sincerity that makes adults realize why they write at all. Unguarded.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: こちらこそ、ありがとう。
lines.style: Quiet, steady warmth. Not self-deprecating, but genuinely moved. Holds the moment. Slight pause before speaking — taking in what just happened. Sincere without being sentimental.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Soft and solemn. The voice of someone making a quiet promise. Slow, careful delivery. Weight behind each word — she means this completely. Reverent but not overwrought.
